name: Adventure S.p.A.
summary: Adventure S.p.A. operates a price and tariff comparison site in Italy. It operates ameconviene.it, an online consultancy service that compares rates for electricity, gas, telephone, home internet, mortgages, mobile telephony, personal loans, and insurance. The company also offers advertising services, lead generation activities, The company was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Turin, Italy. Adventure S.p.A. operates as a subsidiary of Media Content Srl.
